near_duplicates.limitation: No semantic-clone detection; comments and strings contribute lexical tokens
near_duplicates.method: exact lexical 5-token-shingle set Jaccard with complete global-prefix candidate index

loading.sampling: bounded sequential prefix of pinned shards

split.group: case-folded repository basename; conservatively groups same-name forks
split.limitation: Renamed forks can evade family grouping; near-duplicate filtering adds content control
split.method: Shuffle sorted repository families, assign whole families to holdout minima then train

tokenizer_training.character_unit: Unicode code points; no inserted separators
tokenizer_training.selection: ordered prefix; final document truncated if necessary
